verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an integrations framework: data-in integrations each with their own API key, data-out integrations to analytics, CRM, support and ad platforms, and a Pipelines API that it says most of its integrations are built on. However, nothing in the evidence names Stripe, Shopify, Segment, or a product-database connector, so the specific stack this story asks about is unevidenced. Missing for 10: named first-party Stripe/Shopify connectors, Segment/CDP integration, product database/warehouse sync, evidence that integrations are maintained, independent or hands-on corroboration.
